rounds.title: Scheduler baseline
rounds.note: The SDK scheduler (et-scheduler) in flow, first drawing, drawn by the mock from @ethlete/components/design/scheduler with the real markup and CSS: the wide header (outline Today button, filled Add appointment, previous and next icon buttons, the range label, the tabs view switch), et-scheduler-time-grid-view (week and day), et-scheduler-month-view and et-scheduler-agenda-view, the appointment badges (color dot, title, time range, location, chain count) and the resize handles; default labels, en-US times. Fixtures are fictional: one week (Mon March 2 to Sun March 8, 2026, today Wed March 4) with a daily sync, an overlapping parent and nested child (Roadmap planning / Budget check), a selected appointment (Design review, brand), a two-day all-day Conference, Hiring panel and Retro; the colors are the sdk product's registered themes brand (default), warning and danger. The time grid draws 8:00 to 18:00 as if the scrolling body sat on that window, with business hours 9 to 17 on weekdays and the weekend outside them; the current time line sits on today at 11:15. Framed as a page with 16px padding. Widths 560, 800 and 1200 (all above the 480px container width where the header switches to floating action buttons). States: week, week-dragging (Retro lifted, with the drag shadow), appointment-hover, appointment-focus-visible (Daily sync on Monday forced), slot-focus-visible (Thursday 11:00 forced), day, month (outside-month days, today, a +3 more trigger, the selected appointment), month-cell-focus-visible, agenda (a month heading, today, nested rows with tree guides, the selected appointment). Numbers (light / dark), from shot pixels at scale 2 at 800, brand mint, a: appointment tint (14 %) vs page 1.07 / 1.37, its title ink on it 5.12 / 9.84; selected appointment (mint fill) vs page 1.33 / 13.50, its text 15.82 / 15.82; today date circle (mint fill) vs page 1.33 / 13.50, its digit 15.82; current time line and its dot vs the today column 1.29 / 12.14; focus ring (primary) vs page 1.35 / 13.50, vs the appointment tint 1.26 / 9.84; Add appointment fill vs page 1.33 / 13.50, its label 15.82. Q98 numbers only: grid lines (hour rows, day columns, header and all-day edges, month cells) vs page 1.26 / 1.73; the non-business band 1.07 / 1.08; the today column tint is 6 % mint. Decided rules that arise: Q88 (every focus ring: slots, all-day cells, month cells, appointments, the overflow trigger, the view switch, the header buttons), Q99a (the current time line and its dot, the appointment color dot; the selected appointment, the today date circles and the filled Add appointment button are mint fills, so they take a 1px inset ink edge) and Q101 (the filled button hover = -active). The ink edge on a mint fill arises, so Q102 arises: b draws the edges in both schemes, c keeps dark as today (light-dark(ink, transparent)). The 32 / 38 / 44 % selection step does not arise: a selected appointment is a solid mint fill, not a tint. Findings for later: (1) lib bug: the badge pieces render inside their component hosts (et-scheduler-badge-color-dot, -title, -time-range, -location, -chain-count), which are inline, so the flex rules on the inner spans never apply: the color dot is 0 x 0 and never shows (also in Storybook), the title does not take flex: 1 or ellipsis, and the time range and location are cut hard at the block edge (the agenda location shrinks to one letter while the title has room). Fixed in the lib (display: contents on the five hosts; the time range and location shrink with an ellipsis before the title). Narrow week blocks still clip, because the gaps, the dot and the chain count alone are wider than the block (31 px at 560), so data-et-skip CLIPPED stays on every time grid block; the month cell skip is gone. (2) The first hour label sat half above the scroll body (translateY(-50%)) and was clipped by its overflow; fixed in the lib with a top padding of half the label line height. (3) Outside-month dates read nearly like in-month ones. (4) The selected appointment edge and the drag shadow share box-shadow, so a selected appointment being dragged would lose one (not drawn); the lib has no selected edge yet, so whoever merges b or c must list the edge and the drag shadow in one rule on [data-selected][data-dragging]. (5) The Add appointment hover (Q101) is not forced here; it is the same et-button as in the stream round (hover 1.69 from rest). Later rounds, left out here: the edit surface (scheduler-edit-surface and its parts, an overlay), the month +n more menu, the narrow header with floating action buttons, the drag-to-create draft and committed blocks, month draft and drop-target cells, the scrollbar, custom badge adornments, the read-only scheduler, RTL and long labels.

a.note: Today, the lib as is. On light the mint marks sit near 1.3: the current time line 1.29 vs the today column, focus rings 1.35 vs page (1.26 vs the appointment tint), the selected appointment, today circles and Add appointment 1.33 vs page; dark 12.14 / 13.50 / 13.50. The color dot never shows (0 x 0, lib bug). Text: appointment title 5.12 / 9.84 on its tint, selected text 15.82.

b.note: Pick. a plus Q88, Q99a and Q101, decided rules only, edges in both schemes. Q99a: the current time line and its dot take light-dark(ink, primary): light 5.32 vs the today column (was 1.29), dark unchanged 12.14; the color dot gets the same (no number, it stays 0 x 0 until the host bug is fixed). The selected appointment and the today date circles keep the mint with a 1px inset ink edge: light 5.48 vs page, 4.13 vs the fill; in dark the ink is the mint, so the edge merges with the fill (1.00). Q88: every focus ring in ink, light 5.48 vs page (was 1.35), 5.12 vs the appointment tint; dark 13.50 / 9.84. Q101 and the button edge and ring as in the stream b (hover 1.69 from rest). Text unchanged. Picked because these are the only decided rules that apply, they lift every light mark past 3:1, and they match the calendar, timeline and stream b picks. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with every inset ink edge in light-dark(ink, transparent) (Q102): light equals b (edges 5.48 vs page, 4.13 vs fill; time line 5.32; rings 5.48). Dark: no edge on the selected appointment, the today circles or the filled button, as today; rings stay ink (Q88), the time line stays primary as in a. Under the brand theme dark renders the same as b. It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).

d.note: a plus the wrap layout the lead asked to draw for Tom (not in the lib, a new look). Time grid blocks wrap: the title takes its own line, the time range, location and chain count wrap under it; a block under 36px tall (a 30 minute block) hides the wrapped pieces, so no half line shows. Month cell lists under 120px wide hide the time range (the location is already hidden there). In a, narrow blocks cut the time range to '9.' next to the title; in d the title shows in full on its line and the time range shows whole once the block is an hour or taller. Week blocks still clip vertically on purpose, so data-et-skip CLIPPED stays on them; the month view passes without a skip.
